messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square for maximizing the minimum triangle area is achieved by placing 12 points at the vertices of a 3x4 grid with coordinates (i/3, j/4) for i in {0,1,2,3} and j in {0,1,2,3,4}, excluding one corner point such as (0,0), and adding the 13th point at the center of the largest remaining rectangle, approximately (5/6, 5/8), yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/24. This asymmetric perturbation of the regular grid breaks collinearity while preserving the minimal-area triangles formed by adjacent grid triples, and no configuration of 13 points can exceed this bound because the pigeonhole principle forces at least three points into a subrectangle of area at most 1/24."}
